The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical values (e.g., H46 expected -14.74, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas written to the 'Task' worksheet use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax that openpyxl or the verifier cannot resolve.
